sql: select 'paper_trades' as src, strategy, count(*) as n from paper_trades where strategy like 'Emmsell%' group by strategy union all select 'live_orders', strategy, count(*) from live_orders where strategy like 'Emmsell%' group by strategy union all select 'twins', twin_tag, count(*) from live_paper_twins where twin_tag like 'Emmsell%' group by twin_tag union all select 'LIVE_TOTAL_open_now', strategy, count(*) from live_orders where status in ('resting','open','pending','partially_filled') group by strategy
